rows.name: handoff_marker
rows.description: Parser marker. Sets the local handoff marker and makes a later stream switch save the next cursor. It does not call the counter setter.

rows.name: registered_counter_arm
rows.description: Registered-counter arm. Writes `C = 1`.

rows.name: registered_counter_reset
rows.description: Registered-counter reset. Writes `C = 0`.

rows.name: actor_state
rows.description: Actor State selection. Resolves slot, Actor Art Source, Animation, Facing, coordinates, and options. Valid selectors replace State fields and start the pose sequencer.

rows.name: dialogue_window_close_release
rows.description: Closes and releases the dialogue window selected by operand 0, then removes its director-owned tracking record.

rows.name: dialogue_window_resume
rows.description: Resumes the dialogue window selected by operand 0 after its serifu interpreter reaches an `@s` director pause.

rows.name: actor_move
rows.description: Starts or replaces Actor movement. Coordinates use signed fixed point divided by 1000. The helper creates the per-slot motion object and velocities.

rows.name: scene_transform_sequence_start
rows.description: In director mode 0, starts a scene-transform keyframe sequence. Operands select a resource set, sequence group, and ticks per segment. Other modes only consume the command.

rows.name: scene_transform_sequence_query
rows.description: Scene-transform sequence query. In director mode 0, result 1 means no transform job remains. Other modes skip comparison.

rows.name: registered_counter_query
rows.description: Registered-counter query. Produces `C - 1`. This is the exact wait producer in the normalized wait compound.

rows.name: actor_state_pose_opcode_query
rows.description: Actor State pose-program opcode query. It decodes the selected Actor's current normal pose entry. Retail waits compare the raw opcode to zero.

rows.name: dialogue_pause_query
rows.description: Dialogue-pause query. Producer operand selects a window ID. Result 2 means that window reached an `@s` director pause.

rows.name: actor_movement_countdown_query
rows.description: Actor movement query. Returns the signed motion-object countdown for the selected slot, or zero when no motion object exists.

rows.name: reserved_noop_12
rows.description: Defined one-word no-op/reserved command.

rows.name: actor_record_release
rows.description: Destroys one durable Actor record, or all 28. It frees and clears the Actor-table pointer but does not cancel parallel slot jobs.

rows.name: actor_create
rows.description: Creates or reuses a `0x150` Actor slot record, clears it, and initializes art source, animation, facing, coordinates, resolver, and option fields.

rows.name: actor_facing_turn_transition
rows.description: Starts or replaces a timed Actor Facing turn. It walks a 12-phase direction cycle, reselects Actor State at each step, and owns the completion pointer queried by `0x16`.

rows.name: actor_facing_turn_activity_query
rows.description: Actor turn-transition activity query. It produces 1 while the selected `0x15` transition record exists, otherwise 0.

rows.name: text_display_speed_override
rows.description: Sets the global text-display-speed scalar from operand 0's low unsigned halfword. It changes serifu token throughput and scales lowercase `@t` pauses.

rows.name: full_screen_color_overlay_fade
rows.description: Creates or retargets a separately scheduled full-screen solid-color overlay fade. Six operands set duration, RGB, starting alpha, and target alpha.

rows.name: actor_scene_transform_channel_assign
rows.description: In director mode 0, assigns one Actor or all Actors to a scene-transform channel. Operand 0 is an Actor selector; operand 1 is the channel index. Other modes only consume the command.

rows.name: actor_uniform_scale
rows.description: Sets one Actor's uniform render scale, or every existing Actor's scale. Operand 1 is a signed percentage divided by 100 and written to all three scale axes.

rows.name: actor_rgb_tint_transition
rows.description: Starts or replaces one or all Actor RGB-tint transitions. Eligible render calls interpolate Actor bytes `+0x142..+0x144` over operand 7's duration. Operand 8 enables an environment-color combiner.

rows.name: actor_rgb_tint_activity_query
rows.description: Actor RGB-tint activity query. It returns 1 while the selected transition's progress differs from its duration, otherwise 0.

rows.name: reserved_noop_20
rows.description: Defined one-word no-op/reserved command.

rows.name: reserved_payload_skip_3
rows.description: Defined payload skip. Consumes three operand words without another side effect.

rows.name: actor_yaw_offset_set
rows.description: Sets one Actor's yaw offset, or every present Actor's yaw offset. The angle operand uses signed thousandths of a degree.

rows.name: dialogue_control_byte_query
rows.description: Dialogue-control byte query. Compares an unsigned byte from an eight-byte bank. `0xBF` clears it, and serifu `@wSDDD` writes indexed results.

rows.name: actor_sampled_catalog_path
rows.description: Creates or replaces one sampled three-dimensional Actor path. Its operands select the cached catalog, Actor slot, path descriptor, and sample count.

rows.name: scene_resource_slot_presence_query
rows.description: Scene-resource query. Produces 1 when `scene-root + slot*4 + 0x2B8` is non-null, otherwise 0.

rows.name: actor_material_override_set
rows.description: Creates or replaces one slot-owned Actor material override. It selects a combiner, sets environment RGB, and overwrites Actor tint RGB on each eligible render.

rows.name: actor_material_override_release
rows.description: Releases one slot-owned Actor material override. It stops future render overrides but does not restore the Actor's last RGB bytes.

rows.name: actor_body_pose_program_start
rows.description: In director mode 2, initializes or restarts an Actor body-pose program. It selects Actor art, pose state, resource flags, and owner context. Other modes only consume it.

rows.name: actor_body_pose_cycle_query
rows.description: In director mode 2, queries whether an Actor body-pose program remains inside its current cycle. The compare-mode word also selects the Actor.

rows.name: scene_projection_transform_transition
rows.description: Starts a four-channel scene-projection transform. It transitions X/Y translation and X/Y scale. Operand 4 is the divisor and low-halfword update count.

rows.name: scene_projection_transform_countdown_query_mode2
rows.description: Mode-2 scene-projection transform query. Produces the exact sign-extended update count from the singleton transform object.

rows.name: combat_presentation_lifecycle_query
rows.description: Scene combat-presentation lifecycle query. It returns nonnegative phases from `0x801CFC70` unchanged and maps the negative idle state to 1.

rows.name: scene_render_color_transition
rows.description: Starts or replaces one or all 20 scene render-color transitions. Each interpolates RGB across eligible scene updates and modulates matching objects, sprite layers, and shared render passes.

rows.name: registered_object_camera_pose_set
rows.description: Instantly sets the registered-object camera bank's target, eye, and vertical field of view. It always mirrors those seven values into shared renderer camera state.

rows.name: actor_side_camera_pose_set
rows.description: Instantly sets the Actor-side camera bank's target, eye, and vertical field of view. Scene mode 2 also mirrors those values into shared renderer camera state.

rows.name: scene_overlay_lifecycle_switch
rows.description: Scene-overlay lifecycle switch. Zero requests the cutscene presentation reload. Nonzero clears that request and exits alternate director-only scheduling.

rows.name: scene_vignette_image_build
rows.description: Builds a half-resolution RGBA32 vignette from the preloaded RGBA16 scene image, installs it in one of 20 image slots, and configures its transform. Operand 3 is ignored.

rows.name: screen_edge_transition_start
rows.description: Starts a two-edge screen transition. Operands define the initial edges, final edges, duration, and final-state persistence. The scene variant selects title-card reveal or cutscene crop rendering.

rows.name: screen_edge_transition_activity_query
rows.description: Screen-transition activity query. Produces 1 while transition progress differs from its duration, otherwise 0. It follows the same scene variant as `0x3B`.

rows.name: scene_projection_transform_identity_transition
rows.description: Returns the scene-projection transform to identity. Its operand low halfword supplies an update count; zero derives one from the current transform.

rows.name: scene_projection_transform_countdown_query_unguarded
rows.description: Unguarded scene-projection transform query. Produces the exact sign-extended update count shared with `0x2C`, `0x2D`, and `0x3D`.

rows.name: actor_presentation_bootstrap
rows.description: Starts the primary Actor-presentation bootstrap. Its operand is consumed but ignored. The helper builds missing Actors, starts Actor movements, and owns a 28-slot lifecycle vector.

rows.name: actor_presentation_activity_query
rows.description: Actor-presentation activity query. Produces 1 while the shared lifecycle vector exists, otherwise 0.

rows.name: actor_roster_materialize_variant0
rows.description: Materializes selected Actor-input rows into scene Actors. Variant 0 enables the context-and-depth `+26` pose refresh and immediate draw path.

rows.name: animated_scene_sprite_create_explicit
rows.description: Creates or replaces one animated 2D scene sprite with explicit art, Animation, Facing, position, render layer, scale, and resource variant.

rows.name: scene_shadow_light_source_set
rows.description: Sets the scene shadow-light source X, Y, and Z in unscaled world units. A zero Y value disables scene Actor shadow projection.

rows.name: actor_opacity_multiplier_set
rows.description: Sets one Actor's opacity multiplier, or every present Actor's. The renderer combines its low byte with incoming alpha through division by 255.

rows.name: animated_path_ribbon_create
rows.description: Creates or replaces one animated textured path ribbon. It decodes a two-dimensional resource path and builds the ribbon geometry.

rows.name: animated_path_ribbon_endpoint
rows.description: Retargets one existing path ribbon's reveal endpoint by path percentage or source control-point milestone. The milestone operand takes precedence.

rows.name: animated_path_ribbon_release
rows.description: Immediately releases one or all path ribbons, or starts their 30-update fade-and-release sequence.

rows.name: animated_path_ribbon_activity_query
rows.description: Path-ribbon reveal activity query. It reads the selected record's activity byte and enters generic comparison.

rows.name: frozen_frame_iris_transition
rows.description: Closes or opens a feathered black iris while managing a frozen framebuffer. Eight operands define its aperture, target, alpha, duration, and phase. Operand 8 is ignored.

rows.name: frozen_frame_iris_activity_query
rows.description: Frozen-frame iris activity query. It returns 1 while the iris singleton exists and its progress has not passed its duration.

rows.name: image_transform_echo_start
rows.description: Starts a timed, three-copy image transform echo. Operands select draw direction, active duration, and the five-tick fade extension.

rows.name: image_transform_echo_activity_query
rows.description: Returns 1 while the `0x50` image transform echo remains active, otherwise 0.

rows.name: manual_oversized_image_control_update
rows.description: Runs manual oversized-image controls. Analog or D-pad input pans within image bounds; C-buttons animate zoom between 0.7 and 1.0.

rows.name: resynchronization_enable
rows.description: Enables parser resynchronization mode. A later failed condition scans forward to the next barrier. It is control, not a value query.

rows.name: global_halfword_mask_query
rows.description: Mask query. Applies the producer operand to global unsigned halfword `0x800C4B28` and compares the boolean result.

rows.name: scanner_cursor_replace
rows.description: Searches the stream for label `0x80000005` whose marker ID equals operand 0. It replaces the Director cursor with that label's word index and returns.

rows.name: reserved_payload_skip_1_5c
rows.description: Defined one-operand payload skip with no other side effect.

rows.name: scene_background_group_and_unit_presentation_init
rows.description: Loads an ordered scene-background group. Operand 2 selects the group; operand 0 optionally overrides its member count; operand 1 is ignored. It then initializes shared unit/body-presentation state.

rows.name: unresolved_native_command_5e
rows.description: Consumes three native operands. The parser width and dispatch are exact; the active callee meaning remains unresolved.

rows.name: actor_transform_channel_divider_create
rows.description: Creates or updates the per-tick Actor transform-channel divider. Four coordinates define two X/Z points; two channel indices select its sides.

rows.name: combat_aux_body_program_reset
rows.description: Resets one auxiliary combat-presentation body-program controller. Operand 0 selects its 100-byte owner record; operand 1 becomes the signed-halfword program selector.

rows.name: combat_actor_body_program_reset
rows.description: Resets one combat Actor body-program controller. Operand 0 selects the 248-byte combat roster record; operand 1 becomes the signed-halfword program selector.

rows.name: transient_render_entity_create
rows.description: Replaces one of 14 transient render-entity slots. Operand 0 selects the slot; operand 1 selects an overlay-compatible preset from 0 through 34.

rows.name: animated_scene_sprite_create
rows.description: Creates or reuses one of 30 persistent animated 2D scene sprites. It sets position and selects direct, sampled-path, or resource-path rotation.

rows.name: animated_scene_sprite_retarget_restart
rows.description: Restarts or retargets an existing animated 2D scene sprite. It preserves position and rendering controls while resetting animation-program state.

rows.name: animated_scene_sprite_program_opcode_query
rows.description: Animated-sprite program-opcode query. The producer selects one sprite slot; the result is the low unsigned opcode at its current animation cursor.

rows.name: animated_scene_sprite_release
rows.description: Releases scene-root `+0x1AC0` animated-sprite records. Operand `-1` selects all 30 entries; other values select one entry.

rows.name: actor_secondary_y_set
rows.description: Sets an Actor's secondary Y height in signed thousandths. Operand 2 chooses secondary-only or base-plus-secondary rendering and replaces the Actor height-mode byte.

rows.name: transient_render_entity_status_query
rows.description: Queries a transient render-entity slot. It returns `-5` when absent, `-6` when detached, or the slot's current status halfword.

rows.name: transient_render_entity_release
rows.description: Releases one transient render-entity slot and its four owned allocations. Operand `-1` releases all 14 slots.

rows.name: manual_oversized_image_controls_enable
rows.description: Enables manual oversized-image panning and creates its four animated direction indicators. Operand 0 selects their resource set.

rows.name: manual_oversized_image_controls_disable
rows.description: Disables manual oversized-image panning and releases its four direction-indicator records.

rows.name: audio_context_program_operation
rows.description: Starts, replaces, or releases one audio-context program. Action 0 can defer replacement until the old voice ends; selector 7 with action 1 resets all seven contexts.

rows.name: audio_gain_set
rows.description: Sets audio gain immediately. Selectors 0 through 6 set every voice in one context; selector 7 sets the global second gain bus.

rows.name: audio_controller_request
rows.description: Audio/controller request. Selector 7 targets all seven contexts; fixed classes use the 16-entry request queue.

rows.name: audio_context_voice_control
rows.description: Queues one voice-control request for one audio context or all seven. The last non-`-1` operand selects tempo, pan, or pitch.

rows.name: sepia_vignette_scene_cleanup_rebuild
rows.description: Performs mode-dependent scene/UI cleanup, enables the sepia/vignette presentation state, and rebuilds its focus controller.

rows.name: actor_transform_channel_divider_release
rows.description: Releases the per-tick Actor transform-channel divider. Existing Actor channel assignments remain unchanged.

rows.name: scripted_oversized_image_pan_zoom
rows.description: Starts or retargets a timed oversized-image pan. It derives X/Y rates, coordinates the shared zoom controller, and frees its job after the update count.

rows.name: scripted_oversized_image_transition_query
rows.description: Produces 1 while the scripted oversized-image transition job exists, otherwise 0.

rows.name: actor_scheduled_y_step
rows.description: Creates or retargets one Actor's scheduled Y-step job. A positive interval applies repeated deltas; sentinel `-1` derives an every-update step toward an absolute Y target.

rows.name: default_scene_transform_channel
rows.description: Selects the default scene-transform channel for unassigned scene records and Actor body-placement offsets. The safe channel domain is 0 through 19.

rows.name: director_terminal_state_slot_release
rows.description: Stops the director, marks the optional full-screen color overlay for release, and requests permanent scheduler release of the director's state slot.

rows.name: color_overlay_release_and_continue
rows.description: Marks the optional full-screen color overlay for release and continues parsing. The overlay's separate scheduler slot then tears it down.

rows.name: color_overlay_countdown_query
rows.description: Returns the full-screen color overlay's signed remaining-update count, or zero when no overlay object exists.

rows.name: actor_sepia_exemption_refresh
rows.description: Selects one Actor for full-color restoration inside the sepia/vignette effect, then invalidates that Actor's cached images for reconstruction.

rows.name: army_management_board_initialize
rows.description: Initializes the Army Management formation board from its preselected layout variant, then marks the director subsystem active.

rows.name: transient_render_entity_close
rows.description: In the alternate preset overlay, starts a fade-and-rectangle close for linked render entity slot 0 through 13. The generic updater removes it afterward.

rows.name: display_black_after_render_drain
rows.description: Waits for all outstanding graphics tasks, clears any pending reveal, and requests black Video Interface output. It has no operands.

rows.name: display_reveal_after_render_completion
rows.description: Requests Video Interface reveal after the next graphics-completion event. It has no operands and does not wait.

rows.name: army_management_board_destroy
rows.description: Destroys the Army Management board, releases its owned resources, restores prior resource context, and clears the director subsystem-active byte.

rows.name: army_management_cursor_latch_query
rows.description: Army Management cursor-latch query. It returns 0 exactly when the latch byte equals 1, and returns 1 otherwise.

rows.name: army_management_board_suppression_set
rows.description: Sets Army Management board suppression. Low byte 1 disables its updater and renderer; every other value enables both.

rows.name: transient_render_entity_remove_immediate
rows.description: In the alternate preset overlay, immediately unlinks and frees linked render entity slot 0 through 13. The ownership record remains for `0x6B`.

rows.name: army_management_cursor_latch_set
rows.description: Sets the Army Management cursor latch. Values 0, 1, and 2 select unlatched, ready-latched, and tracking-without-readiness states.

rows.name: reserved_payload_skip_1_8d
rows.description: Defined one-operand payload skip with no other side effect.

rows.name: reserved_payload_skip_2_8e
rows.description: Defined two-operand payload skip with no other side effect.

rows.name: persistent_global_flag_query
rows.description: Persistent-global-flag query. It adds `0xAA` before signed-halfword narrowing, reads the saved Boolean bank, and compares the result.

rows.name: actor_gender_alignment_profile_query
rows.description: Actor gender/Alignment profile query. The producer selects an Actor slot. It returns `3 * Gender + floor(clamp(Alignment, 0, 98) / 33)`, applies 22 story-class overrides, and returns -1 for a missing Actor or class source.

rows.name: actor_swap_by_class_family
rows.description: In director mode 2, finds the first Actor-input row matching operand 1's class family. It swaps that linked Actor into operand 0's scene slot and repairs both Actors' slot fields. Other modes only consume the command.

rows.name: army_management_presentation_mode_set
rows.description: In director mode 2, sets Army Management board presentation from operand 0: 0 shows all layers brightly, 1 focuses the selected formation and its members, and every other byte suppresses the controlled board layers.

rows.name: actor_swap_by_battle_grid_cell
rows.description: In director mode 2, treats operand 1 as a one-based 3-by-9 battle-grid cell, finds the Actor-input row at that cell, and swaps its linked Actor into operand 0's scene slot. Other modes only consume the command.

rows.name: deployed_actor_roster_rebuild
rows.description: In director mode 2, ignores operand 0, removes every deployed-source Actor-input row and its registered auxiliaries, rebuilds the roster from first deployed unit record 30, and makes 30 current. Other modes only consume the command.

rows.name: alternate_director_only_scheduler_enter
rows.description: Enters alternate director-only scheduling. It suppresses Actor movement, pose updates, the camera updater, and selected pre-render work.

rows.name: pending_substream_call_selector
rows.description: Arms a one-level Director substream call from operand 0's low byte. Parsing continues until `0x80000000`, which saves the return state and loads that continuation stream.

rows.name: pending_substream_return
rows.description: Arms a one-level Director substream return. Parsing continues until `0x80000000`, which frees the current substream and restores the saved stream and cursor.

rows.name: cutscene_ground_surface_load
rows.description: Loads the cutscene ground-surface mesh. Operand 0 indexes its one-entry resource table, so this ROM requires zero. Flagged mode-0 Actors then derive Y from X/Z.

rows.name: actor_ground_height_placement_toggle
rows.description: Disables or enables automatic ground-height placement for one Actor slot. Operand 0 value `-1` selects all 28 slots.

rows.name: actor_explicit_height_reset
rows.description: Selects one Actor or all 28. Operand 1 sets base Y, with `-1` preserving it. It zeroes vertical offset, disables terrain following, and selects base-plus-offset rendering.

rows.name: actor_roster_source_query
rows.description: Actor roster-source query. The producer selects an Actor slot. It returns 0 for absent or unlinked, 1 for persistent-character source, or 2 for deployed-character source.

rows.name: filtered_actor_presentation_start
rows.description: Starts filtered Actor-presentation movements. Operand 0 selects one of six Actor groups. It shares the `0x3F` lifecycle vector and updater.

rows.name: filtered_actor_presentation_activity_query
rows.description: Produces 1 when scene-root `+0x1CA8` is non-null, otherwise 0. It shares the exact accessor used by `0x40`.

rows.name: current_unit_member_actor_bind
rows.description: Current-unit member Actor slot binder. Operand 1 selects one of the current unit's five members. The linked deployed Actor is swapped into scene slot operand 0.

rows.name: actor_rgb_tint_release_restore
rows.description: Releases one Actor RGB-tint record and restores white tint. Value `-1` walks 30 entries, overlapping the first two adjacent Actor-path pointers.

rows.name: special_actor_black_fade_start
rows.description: Starts the fixed 60-update special-Actor black fade. The full-screen overlay reaches opaque black while Actors in States `0x51`–`0x53` or `0xA3` remain visible above it.

rows.name: positioned_mode2_controller_signal
rows.description: Signals the positioned mode-2 controller created by `0x80000009`. Value 0 arms the main finish sequence. Value 1 advances that sequence or signals selector 1's child.

rows.name: actor_roster_materialize_variant1
rows.description: Runs the same Actor-roster materializer as `0x45`. Variant 1 bypasses only the context-and-depth `+26` pose refresh and immediate draw path.

rows.name: alternate_help_text_section_replace
rows.description: Replaces one alternate-preset render entity's text with help section `operand 1 + 13`, then rebuilds its text layout.

rows.name: prologue_title_alpha_fade_in
rows.description: Prologue Title alpha fade-in. Restarts alpha at zero, adds 3 per eligible scene update, and reaches opaque after 85 updates.

rows.name: prologue_title_secondary_image_reveal
rows.description: Prologue Title secondary-image reveal. Clears, centers, and positions images 2 through 4, then starts their sequential randomized gradient wipes.

rows.name: prologue_title_reveal_query
rows.description: Prologue Title reveal query. Produces 1 while any secondary-image reveal counter remains active, otherwise 0.

rows.name: start_button_skip_arm
rows.description: Arms Start-button cutscene skipping. A scene update latches Start, and the next executed control bridge jumps to marker ID `0x3039`.

rows.name: start_button_skip_disarm
rows.description: Disarms Start-button cutscene skipping and cancels a latched request that has not reached a control bridge.

rows.name: audio_gain_envelope_configure
rows.description: Configures an audio gain envelope. Operands select the table entry, signed half-step, initial level, consumer count, and output group.

rows.name: a_button_skippable_registered_wait_query
rows.description: Implements an A-button-skippable registered wait. A forces `C = target + 1`; otherwise, the query reports `C - 1` normally.

rows.name: chaos_frame_adjust_signed_delta
rows.description: When the alternate presentation context is absent, adds operand 0's signed low byte to Chaos Frame and clamps the result to 0 through 100.

rows.name: standard_render_context_switch
rows.description: Switches to the standard 320×240 triple-buffer render context, enables standard-framebuffer identity tracking, and sets controller mode 2.

rows.name: high_resolution_render_context_switch
rows.description: Switches to the 640×480 double-buffer render context, disables standard-framebuffer identity tracking, and sets controller mode 1.

rows.name: director_teardown
rows.description: Full director teardown. Stops three resident subsystems, saves controller state, releases the stream, clears its base, runs final transition cleanup, and returns.

rows.name: world_clock_daytime_query
rows.description: World-clock daytime query. Produces 1 from hour 6 through hour 17, inclusive, and 0 from hour 18 through hour 5.

rows.name: alternate_presentation_context_presence_query
rows.description: Produces 1 when global pointer `0x8018F1A4` is non-null, otherwise 0.

rows.name: chaos_frame_band_query
rows.description: Reads global byte `0x801936A9`, computes `floor(value / 34)`, clamps values above 2 to 2, and compares that result.

rows.name: dialogue_window_create
rows.description: Creates a dialogue window, selects its serifu text and portrait, and controls Actor-linked or explicit placement, portrait side, mirroring, and pointer edge.

rows.name: mission_briefing_subordinate_actor_bootstrap
rows.description: Mission-briefing subordinate Actor bootstrap. It selects the first eligible persistent-character row, binds up to three animation objects, resolves pose resources, and starts their sequencers.

rows.name: battle_environment_depth_color_clear
rows.description: Clears both RGB endpoints of the selected battle-environment depth-color row. Later body renderers emit black environment color at every depth.

rows.name: control_bridge_and_pending_substream_handoff
rows.description: Control bridge. It owns conditional layout, records a marked resume cursor, and executes any pending `0x99` call or `0x9A` return. The following query remains its own `Q3` or `Q4` record.

rows.name: stream_terminal_hold
rows.description: Terminal hold. The parser returns `-1` without advancing its cursor, freeing either stream level, or reading the asset trailer.

rows.name: branch_barrier
rows.description: Branch barrier sentinel. Failed-condition scanners use it as a depth-matched destination.

rows.name: top_level_stream_tail_call
rows.description: Top-level Director tail-call. Operand 0 selects a new top-level stream; the handler replaces both stream levels and resets the cursor.

rows.name: reserved_payload_skip_1_extended_04
rows.description: Defined one-operand payload skip with no other side effect.

rows.name: director_label_marker
rows.description: Defines a searchable Director label using operand 0 as its marker ID. Marker `0x70` also advances the preset-4 text-panel handshake.

rows.name: scene_background_presentation_initialize
rows.description: Background and presentation initialization. Mode 2 uses a separate battle initializer. Other modes load the selected scene-background group's native member count, then initialize shared unit/body-presentation state.

rows.name: reserved_payload_skip_1_extended_07
rows.description: Defined one-operand payload skip with no other side effect.

rows.name: captured_frame_scene_transition
rows.description: Creates a captured-frame scene transition. Selector 2 enters sepia/vignette, selector 3 restores normal presentation, and selector 4 fades the normal Actor pass.

rows.name: positioned_mode2_controller_create
rows.description: Creates one of six positioned mode-2 controllers. Operand 0 selects callback 0 through 5. Operands 1 through 3 are coordinates divided by 1000.

rows.name: scene_actor_combat_action
rows.description: Submits one Combat Action ID for two pairs of scene Actors. Operand 0 is ID 0 through 135; operands 1 through 4 are Actor slots split two per side.
